name: contract-generated-registry-canonical
goal: Reject generated projects with stale or noncanonical unit registries

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Commit 5b280466ff emits a library registry that validates structurally but units check rejects as noncanonical: testing precedes neither budgets nor its own states.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The existing template case parsed the manifest and rendered its Example but never passed the full generated project through registry admission; the existing CLI case does, but its laptop run is still queued.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: The existing template case rejects the generated entry.index as stale while the other four cases pass.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Emit fields in the declared schema order and retain the existing template case as a full generated-registry admission guard.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Emit the authored examples and budgets in registry schema order.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The same five cases pass at 9e63736d55; the generated registry now has no admission or staleness errors.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Isolated mutant a9aa17b860 restored the rejected ordering: capture e74889267a62 fails one case. Restored source 9e63736d55 passes all five in capture 4ee0a934b4fd.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
